resources.string: Reboot never resumes simulation. FORCE_REAL is retained; AUTO waits for fresh vehicle state and a new confirmed start.
This credential authorizes Tasker commands. Anyone with it can send commands while integration is enabled. Tasker backups and the clipboard may expose it. Revoke it if shared.\n\n%s
Credential copied. Keep Tasker backups private and clear the clipboard after setup.

Enable Tasker integration before revealing a credential.
Seconds after a car disconnect event before requesting simulation (0–3600). Android may still require a visible confirmation.
Enter a whole number from 0 to 3600.
